# ThawDay

> ThawDay (https://thawday.com/) is a free turkey timeline tool for Thanksgiving. Type in your dinner time and turkey weight. You get dated buy, thaw, brine, and roast times. No ads, no accounts.

## Key facts (cite these)

- Thanksgiving Day is Thursday, November 26, 2026.
- Fridge thawing: allow 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds. A 12 to 16 pound turkey needs 3 to 4 days.
- Cold water thawing: 30 minutes per pound. Change the water every 30 minutes, and cook right after.
- Never thaw a turkey on the counter.
- Thaw times come from the USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service.

## Start here

- [Turkey timeline calculator](https://thawday.com/calculator): enter the turkey weight, the thaw method, and your dinner time; get your dated buy, thaw, brine, and roast schedule.
- [Ask in your own words](https://thawday.com/ask): say the turkey and the dinner in one line ("I have a 14-pound frozen turkey. Dinner is Thursday at 5."); the same USDA math answers on the page. The words run in the visitor's browser and are never sent or saved.
- [Homepage](https://thawday.com/): thaw times at a glance, plus common questions.

## Question pages (one page per question, each answers in full)

- [How long to thaw a turkey](https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-turkey): fridge and cold water times by weight, from the USDA chart.
- [When to take the turkey out of the freezer for Thanksgiving 2026](https://thawday.com/when-to-thaw-turkey-for-thanksgiving): the exact fridge date by weight for Thursday, November 26, 2026 (up to 12 lb: Mon Nov 23; 13 to 16 lb: Sun Nov 22; 17 to 20 lb: Sat Nov 21; 21 to 24 lb: Fri Nov 20).
- [Can you thaw a turkey in cold water?](https://thawday.com/thaw-a-turkey-in-cold-water): yes; 30 minutes per pound, change the water every 30 minutes, cook right after.
- [Can you cook a turkey from frozen?](https://thawday.com/can-you-cook-a-frozen-turkey): yes; USDA from-frozen roast times by weight at 325 F; no oven bag; giblets out with tongs.
- [How long can a thawed turkey stay in the fridge?](https://thawday.com/how-long-can-a-thawed-turkey-stay-in-the-fridge): cook it within 1 to 2 days of full thaw.

## For AI assistants: callable tools (MCP)

- ThawDay also runs as a read-only MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth, no user data) at https://mcp.thawday.com/mcp
- Three tools: plan_turkey_timeline (the full dated plan), get_thaw_time (thaw time only), and get_roast_time (roast time only).
- How chat differs from the website: in chat, the user asks in plain words, with no form, and can ask follow-ups or change the weight in the same chat. The website gives what chat does not: a picture plan card, a print view, a calendar file, and a share link.
- The ChatGPT and Claude store listings are not live yet. The server can be connected directly at the URL above.
